mapper.sql: AUDIT_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_KEY, ACTION, BEFORE_VAL, AFTER_VAL, EFF_FROM, EMP_ID, GLOBAL_TX_ID, CHG_DT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_PRM_AUDIT WHERE TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType} AND GLOBAL_TX_ID = #{globalTxId} ORDER BY AUDIT_ID LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRM_AUDIT (TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_KEY, ACTION, BEFORE_VAL, AFTER_VAL, EFF_FROM, EMP_ID, GLOBAL_TX_ID, CHG_DT) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetKey}, #{action}, #{beforeVal}, #{afterVal}, #{effFrom}, #{empId}, #{globalTxId}, #{chgDt})
